briefdescription.para: macOS debug session implementation using LLVM's liblldb SB API.

detaileddescription.para: Platform counterpart to Session.cpp (Windows dbgeng). Implements the Session interface declared in Session.h using lldb::SBDebugger, SBTarget, SBProcess, SBThread, and SBFrame.
Threading model: single-threaded. All SB API calls happen on the main thread. Event polling via SBListener::WaitForEvent drives the deferred-event state machine defined in Session.h (State struct).
Lifecycle: initialize → (launch | attach) → pollEvents loop → shutdown.
